def create_authorization_response(self, uri, http_method='GET', body=None,
                                  headers=None, scopes=None, credentials=None):
    """Extract response_type and route to the designated handler."""
    request = Request(
        uri, http_method=http_method, body=body, headers=headers)
    request.scopes = scopes
    request.user = None
    for k, v in (credentials or {}).items():
        setattr(request, k, v)
    
    response_type_handler = self.response_types.get(
        request.response_type, self.default_response_type_handler)
    log.debug('Dispatching response_type %s request to %r.',
              request.response_type, response_type_handler)
    
    # Validate the authorization request first
    validated_scopes, validated_credentials = response_type_handler.validate_authorization_request(request)
    
    # Update request with validated values
    request.scopes = validated_scopes
    for k, v in validated_credentials.items():
        setattr(request, k, v)
    
    # Create and return the authorization response
    return response_type_handler.create_authorization_response(
        request, self.default_token_type)
